material_params — DRIVE terrain op

• 数据种类:无 → table(仅由参数决定的算子 —— 不接受图像或数据输入)

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.material_params(seed: 'int' = 0, grain: 'float' = 0.05, puddle_level: 'float' = 0.55, puddle_freq: 'float' = 0.6, stain_level: 'float' = 0.6, stain_freq: 'float' = 0.9, wear: 'float' = 0.6, wear_freq: 'float' = 2.0, grass_var: 'float' = 0.1, sky=(0.62, 0.75, 0.92)) -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import driveterrain; driveterrain.material_params(seed: 'int' = 0, grain: 'float' = 0.05, puddle_level: 'float' = 0.55, puddle_freq: 'float' = 0.6, stain_level: 'float' = 0.6, stain_freq: 'float' = 0.9, wear: 'float' = 0.6, wear_freq: 'float' = 2.0, grass_var: 'float' = 0.1, sky=(0.62, 0.75, 0.92)) -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsdrive.get("material_params"))

用法

材质参数表。puddle = Perlin(puddle_freq) > puddle_level 之处(仅道路内侧，标签 11，颜色 = 反射 refl·天空 + (1−refl)·带阴影的路面)，stain = 同样方式的暗色污渍(标签仍为道路，保留在真值场 "stain" 中)，wear = 白线磨损率 clip(wear·(Perlin(wear_freq)·0.5+0.5)·2, 0, 1)。
